hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches with a time-gated FairLaunch period: it blocks trading before a scheduled publish timestamp, fills buy-only swaps from a pre-seeded one-sided liquidity position during FairLaunch, and distributes custom swap fees to referrers, creators, protocol, and inspired parties after the FairLaunch closes.
